video_goal: Demonstrate the step-by-step physical layout of a 10-card Celtic Cross tarot reading.
required_subjects_and_props: Rider-Waite-Smith tarot deck, dark velvet reading cloth, hands

outline_steps.visual_action: Hands place a classic Rider-Waite-Smith tarot deck, showing the distinctive blue and white patterned card backs, onto a dark velvet cloth.
Hands shuffle the Rider-Waite-Smith deck using a gentle overhand shuffle, briefly revealing flashes of the classic yellow and blue artwork on the card faces.
The left hand cuts the deck into three separate piles on the velvet cloth, then restacks them into a single pile.
The right hand draws the top card and places it face-up in the exact center of the cloth.
The hand draws a second card and places it horizontally across the center of the first card, forming a physical cross shape.
The hand draws a third card and places it face-up directly below the central cross.
The hand draws a fourth card and places it face-up directly to the left of the central cross.
The hand draws a fifth card and places it face-up directly above the central cross.
The hand draws a sixth card and places it face-up directly to the right of the central cross, completing the 6-card cross formation.
The hand moves to the far right side of the cloth and places a seventh card face-up, starting a new vertical column.
The hand draws an eighth card and places it face-up directly above the seventh card in the right-side column.
The hand draws a ninth card and places it face-up directly above the eighth card.
The hand places the tenth and final card face-up at the top of the right-side column, completing the 4-card vertical 'Staff' formation.
Both hands gently tap the edges of the cards to perfectly align the completed 10-card Celtic Cross layout on the velvet cloth.
